context: Revalidate repository/PR/revision evidence and capability introspection first, run the exact pinned baseline and compatibility tests, then update capability behavior or documentation only if evidence requires it. Keep the gate fail closed for missing, stale, or broadened baseline evidence and wire the check as required CI.
description: PR #1472 pins four exact MCP conformance baseline IDs and was open without reported status checks at review time. The modern server advertises prompts, resources, and tools list_changed capabilities because a listen handler is served. Re-run the pinned conformance and Inspector checks after remediation, verify the exact revision and static registries, and make an explicit policy decision to retain or disable list_changed unless notification behavior is complete. No baseline change may hide a runtime failure.

anti_patterns.dont: Do not call static registry comparison a complete capability test
anti_patterns.instead: Introspect and exercise the advertised capability
anti_patterns.why: Advertised list-change support also requires notification semantics

anti_patterns.dont: Do not infer readiness from an open PR with no reported checks
anti_patterns.instead: Record the current head and require explicit status evidence
anti_patterns.why: Missing status evidence is not a pass

anti_patterns.dont: Do not replace a failing runtime assertion with a new baseline ID or an expanded known-failure prefix
anti_patterns.instead: Fix the behavior or record a separately reviewed, revision-bound baseline update
anti_patterns.why: That would convert a real regression into a false green gate

preserves.behavior: Conformance and Inspector failures remain release-blocking; no known-failure prefix is broadened.
No credentials, live endpoint, or unpublished artifact is embedded in baseline evidence.
The four exact baseline IDs remain revision-bound and auditable.

prior_art.concept: list_changed capability advertisement and listener path
four exact protocol baseline IDs and fail-closed verification
